result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to proceed with developing a dedicated handoff tracking tool targeting small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of handoff workflows and recurring alignment friction in small software teams based in Latvia.
- Assessment of necessary integrations with existing developer collaboration and issue-tracking platforms.
- Excludes any payroll, accounting, compensation tracking, or financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Supervises sprint deliverables, daily handoffs, and team operational rituals.

- How many hours per week does your engineering team spend compiling and distributing handoff updates? (question-d4f484afa138a6c4376e2352)
- Which project tracking and messaging tools must a handoff tracker interface with to fit into your existing routine? (question-0aa9722d18fb9376fcd0f065)

## Product Operations Manager

Oversees cross-functional delivery cadence, software tooling budgets, and process improvements.

- Under what pricing model and budget allocation would your organization consider purchasing a specialized handoff tracker? (question-72974be6368c3a5b1e2c69e2)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia currently rely on manual copy-pasting or ad-hoc messages to coordinate weekly handoffs.
- Teams are experiencing measurable productivity loss due to fragmented handoff communications.

## Evidence gaps

- Empirical data from non-synthetic customer discovery interviews across Latvian software businesses is currently absent.
- Evaluation of regional competitors or existing issue tracker add-ons serving the Baltic tech ecosystem is not yet established.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
